collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A sanitation worker asks how an imagined city of thousands could keep its water and streets clean.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After clearing refuse from the shore, a sanitation worker asks how an imagined city of thousands could keep its water and streets clean.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Builders sketch separate routes for drinking water and waste; the discussion improves their own sanitation practices.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The proposed channel threatens a garden; the group learns that infrastructure has consequences.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Children appoint themselves inspectors and find an embarrassing number of neglected baskets.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A worker asks whether the cleaners receive fair pay and protection; the council discusses unseen labor.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A healer explains how contamination might make crowded communities vulnerable to illness.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The village remembers its own lapses and quietly organizes a cleanup rather than mocking imaginary outsiders.
